asked.item: Why no DM arrived after commenting GUIDE on own reel from the business account

verdict.reason: The pages state that comments from the connected account itself are skipped and describe how to test from a different account.

steps.text: Blotato skips comments posted by the same Instagram account or Facebook Page connected to the automation, so your own comment does not start a run or send a direct message.
To test, publish the automation, sign in to a different Instagram or Facebook account, and leave a new top-level comment on the target post using one of the keywords.
Then confirm the other account receives the direct message.
